question: Will Mitch McConnell speak this year?
resolution_criteria:
Will there be any video / audio recording / other evidence of Mitch McConnell speaking from today (July 7th) until the end of the year.  I must be able to view/hear it with my own eyes/ears.  If an extremely credible source (NYT? WaPo? idk) releases an article that corroborates Mitch McConnell speaking (say, a journalist spoke with him), that would count.  Using augmented voice technology to speak would count as well.

I will not bet on this market.
research:
As of 2026-08-27, the question is not clearly settled. The likely resolving event is a July 7 phone call: Sen. John Barrasso's office says he spoke with McConnell, and AP and the Washington Post reported it. But that is second-hand through a staffer, and I found no recording or first-hand journalist contact during the window. The Manifold page and several news sites (Salon, NPR, McConnell's own site) refused my connections, so some details below come only from search-result summaries.

## 1. Resolution source
- No URL or data series decides this. The question creator judges it on their own, based on any video or audio, or a credible outlet (NYT or WaPo level) confirming that McConnell spoke. The window runs from July 7 to the end of the year.
- The market itself appears to be Manifold's "Will Mitch McConnell speak this year?" by user "bens". A search snapshot showed about 86%, but I couldn't load the page, so I can't confirm the date or the current price. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/bens/will-mitch-mcconnell-speak-this-yea)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-07-07: Barrasso's office said Barrasso spoke with McConnell by phone that Tuesday afternoon for about 20 minutes. They said they discussed Graham Platner and Maine, a Supreme Court ruling on coordinated spending, the NDAA and the nominee for director of national intelligence, and that McConnell "was fully engaged." This falls inside the window, but it is a staffer's account, not a recording. [Gray DC/WBTV](https://www.wbtv.com/2026/07/07/senate-republican-leaders-say-theyve-spoken-with-mcconnell-amid-hospitalization/); [WaPo](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/07/07/health-rumors-swirl-gop-leaders-say-theyve-spoken-with-mcconnell/)
- 2026-07-06: Majority Leader Thune's office said he and McConnell had a "lengthy and substantive" phone call. That was one day before the window opened. [X/Laura Weiss](https://x.com/LauraEWeiss16/status/2074547412530553095)
- Early July: commentator Scott Jennings said he talked with McConnell for "just shy of 20 minutes." CNN later said it had not confirmed this, and on air Jennings said "I haven't spoken to him" recently. I couldn't confirm when the call happened. [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/scott-jennings-hit-with-mitch-mcconnell-call-challenge-on-air/); [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/controversy-mitch-mcconnell-absence-conflicting-reports-1817918)
- When USA Today asked about related audio, McConnell's office neither confirmed nor denied it. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/mitch-mcconnell-still-hospitalized-spoke-181813457.html)
- I found no video, audio or on-camera remarks from McConnell since June 14. Only written statements and two photos have been released. [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/mitch-mcconnell-sparks-new-mystery-with-op-ed-attack-on-trump); [Salon](https://www.salon.com/2026/08/03/mitch-mcconnell-is-never-coming-back-to-the-senate/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-26: His office put out a press release on federal funding for a University of Kentucky ag research building. It is written only. [mcconnell.senate.gov](https://www.mcconnell.senate.gov/public/index.cfm/pressreleases)
- 2026-08-06: In a written statement, he said he had left the rehab center and would do intensive physical therapy at home through the August recess. He gave no return date. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/06/politics/mitch-mcconnell-discharged); [The Hill](https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/6015029-mitch-mcconnell-discharged-rehabilitation-center/); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/06/mitch-mcconnell-health-update-senate-gop.html)
- 2026-08-06: He voted by proxy in a farm bill committee vote, which failed. [mcconnell.senate.gov](https://www.mcconnell.senate.gov/public/index.cfm/2026/8/update-from-senator-mitch-mcconnell)
- 2026-08-04: He missed the Fancy Farm picnic in Kentucky. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/04/nx-s1-5918587/mitch-mcconnells-absence-looms-large-over-annual-kentucky-picnic)
- 2026-08-03: Salon (an opinion piece) said he had not been seen or heard in public since mid-June, and that the two photos of him with Elaine Chao had only added to speculation. [Salon](https://www.salon.com/2026/08/03/mitch-mcconnell-is-never-coming-back-to-the-senate/)
- Around 2026-07-21: The Daily Beast reported a Capitol Police detail outside the hospital 37 days after he was admitted. [Alternet](https://www.alternet.org/mcconnell-health/)
- 2026-07-12: In a written statement, he said a fall caused the hospitalization, that he was briefly unconscious and had mild pneumonia, and that there was no stroke, heart attack or tumor. He said he was "regaining my strength" in rehab. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/13/nx-s1-5891492/mcconnell-fall-hospitalization)
- 2026-06-14: He was admitted to the hospital. [ABC](https://abcnews.com/Politics/mcconnell-discharged-rehab-facility/story?id=135434047)

## 4. Base rates
- His past health episodes ended with him back in public within weeks:
  - March 2023: a concussion after a fall, followed by rehab. He phoned colleagues within weeks and returned to the Senate after about six weeks. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/mitch-mcconnell-update-health-return-to-senate-gop-senators)
  - 2023: after his freezing episodes, he gave public remarks again soon afterward. [Yahoo](https://news.yahoo.com/mitch-mcconnell-makes-first-public-201632323.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall)
  - December 2024: a fall that sprained his wrist, and he worked from home briefly. [ABC](https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/mcconnell-absent-senate-thursday-recovers-fall-capitol-116732905)
- This absence, at more than 10 weeks with no public audio or video, is the longest of these. He is 84, and his term ends 2027-01-03, so the window covers about 4 more months of his time as a senator.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold, "speak this year" (this question): about 86% in a search snapshot of unknown date. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/bens/will-mitch-mcconnell-speak-this-yea)
- Manifold, "verifiable live public appearance before 2027": about 57% in a snapshot of unknown date. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/yeeta/will-mitch-mcconnell-make-a-verifia-6lZQULNEc2)
- Manifold, "appearance before Aug 3": about 16% on July 11 and about 5% later. It resolved on August 2, and I couldn't find which way. [Tech Insider](https://tech-insider.org/mcconnell-public-appearance-prediction-market-odds-2026/)
- Polymarket, "McConnell casts a Senate vote by Aug 31": dropped from about 22% to about 1% after his August 6 discharge. [Tech Insider](https://tech-insider.org/mcconnell-public-appearance-prediction-market-odds-2026/)
- Kalshi, "resigns early": about 17% after July 12, and about 16¢ on July 28. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/KXRETIREMM-26); [TheLines](https://www.thelines.com/prediction-markets/trending/prediction-markets-news-today-july-7-mcconnell-debt-world-cup/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (around 2026-09-15)
- The Senate comes back from the August recess in early to mid September. If he returns to the Capitol, he would likely be seen by reporters and cameras.
- His recovery at home could produce phone calls with colleagues, interviews or recorded messages.
- How the question creator rules on the July 7 Barrasso call, which was reported by AP and WaPo, may decide the outcome no matter what happens next.
- The midterm campaign is running (Maine and the Kentucky Senate race) and could lead to statements from him.

  - There has been no audio or video since June 14.
  - The office would neither confirm nor deny audio when asked.
  - Scott Jennings' claim of a call is contested.
  - The Manifold market for a verifiable live appearance before 2027 is only about 57%.
  - Polymarket's market on a Senate vote by August 31 fell to about 1%.
  - Only written statements have been issued, including the August 6 one, which gave no return date.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- **No:** The creator rejects second-hand staffer accounts. McConnell stays home through September and does not return to the floor. If evaluation happens around mid-September, or if he simply never records anything before his term ends, it resolves No.
- **Yes:** He returns when the Senate reconvenes in September, or releases a video message, or gives a phone interview to a Kentucky outlet. Alternatively, the creator accepts the WaPo-reported July 7 call.

**(f) From base rate to final probability.** I start from about 70% for eventual speech by year end and add a bump for the July 7 WaPo corroboration, which gives about 80%. That is somewhat below the 86% Manifold anchor, whose snapshot date is unknown. I then discount for the risk that this question is effectively judged around September 15, before a likely return or farewell speech. I also discount because the creator evidently did not treat the Barrasso call as sufficient right away. That brings me to the low 70s.

Probability: 71%
